repos.description: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent – Captures everything your agent does during sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context back into future sessions. Works with Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, Hermes, Copilot, OpenCode + More
repos.intro: Claude-Mem seamlessly preserves context across sessions by automatically capturing tool usage observations, generating semantic summaries, and making them available to future sessions. This enables Claude to maintain continuity of knowledge about projects even after sessions end or reconnect.
repos.description_zh: 為每個 Agent 提供跨 Session 的持久 Context – 擷取您的 Agent 在 Session 期間所做的一切，透過 AI 進行壓縮，並將相關的 Context 注入未來的 Session 中。支援 Claude Code、OpenClaw、Codex、Gemini、Hermes、Copilot、OpenCode 等更多工具。
repos.intro_zh: Claude-Mem 透過自動擷取工具使用觀察（tool usage observations）、生成語義摘要（semantic summaries），並將其提供給未來的 Session，從而實現跨 Session 的無縫 Context 保留。這讓 Claude 即使在 Session 結束或重新連線後，仍能維持對專案知識的連續性。
repos.description_src: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent – Captures everything your agent does during sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context back into future sessions. Works with Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, Hermes, Copilot, OpenCode + More

repos.description: Worktrunk is a CLI for Git worktree management, designed for parallel AI agent workflows
repos.intro: Worktrunk is a CLI for git worktree management, designed for running AI agents in parallel.
features: Hooks — run commands on create, pre-merge, post-merge, etc
LLM commit messages — generate commit messages from diffs
Merge workflow — squash, rebase, merge, clean up in one command
Interactive picker — browse worktrees with streaming CI status and diff, log, PR and comment previews
Share build caches — ten worktrees get target/ , node_modules/ , etc without building or copying them (on APFS, btrfs, and XFS)
wt list --full — CI status and AI-generated summaries per branch

Merge workflow — 使用單一指令完成 squash、rebase、merge 與清理
Interactive picker — 瀏覽 worktrees，並提供串流式的 CI 狀態以及 diff、log、PR 與 comment 預覽
Share build caches — 十個 worktrees 可以共用 target/、node_modules/ 等內容，無需重新建置或複製（支援 APFS、btrfs 與 XFS）

repos.description: A hierarchical inference engine for frontier MoE models: hot experts on the GPU (CUDA, Vulkan), warm ones in RAM, cold ones streamed from NVMe. Written in C, runs on the hardware you already own.
repos.intro: Tiny engine, immense model. colibri runs very large open models on the machine you already have. A mixture-of-experts model of hundreds of billions of parameters uses only a small part of itself for each token, so colibri keeps that part in RAM and reads the rest, the experts, from the disk when the model asks for them…
features: RAM is two numbers: below the first the model does not start, from the second it runs as measured.
GPU is what the setup can build for that engine ( GPUs ). Integrated too means it also uses an integrated GPU, where these engines were meas…
Measured is what was timed on the machine named, decode speed for the chat models. The letters are machines listed under the tables.
repos.description_zh: 一個用於尖端 MoE 模型的階層式推論引擎：熱門專家位於 GPU (CUDA, Vulkan)，溫熱專家位於 RAM，冷卻專家則從 NVMe 串流。使用 C 語言編寫，可在您現有的硬體上執行。
repos.intro_zh: 微型引擎，龐大模型。colibri 能在您現有的機器上執行極大型的開源模型。擁有數千億參數的 Mixture-of-Experts 模型在處理每個 token 時僅使用其一小部分，因此 colibri 將該部分保留在 RAM 中，並在模型需要時從磁碟讀取其餘部分（即專家）……
features_zh: RAM 有兩個數字：低於第一個數字模型無法啟動，從第二個數字開始則可按測量值執行。
GPU 是該引擎配置可以建構的內容 ( GPUs )。Integrated 也代表它同樣支援整合式 GPU，而這些引擎在整合式 GPU 上的表現測量……
Measured 是指在指定機器上進行的時間測試，即聊天模型的解碼速度 (decode speed)。字母代表表格下方列出的機器。
repos.description_src: A hierarchical inference engine for frontier MoE models: hot experts on the GPU (CUDA, Vulkan), warm ones in RAM, cold ones streamed from NVMe. Written in C, runs on the hardware you already own.
